no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Issuer (formerly Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals) divested all pharmaceutical assets: UK subsidiary Cyclacel Limited (which held the fadraciclib transcriptional-regulation program) was liquidated on Jan 24, 2025; the remaining anti-mitotic asset plogosertib was sold in early October 2025. The 10-K explicitly states the Company does not expect to incur further material R&D expenditures and has pivoted to fire-safety equipment via the Sept 12, 2025 acquisition of Fitters Sdn. Bhd.
